answers.expected_answer: Three random pods; lowest numbered in A, next B, next A, all Locked. Bag: 1 Blank, 4 Larvae, 1 Creeper, 1 Queen, 7 Adults.

Remove Objectives requiring more players than present; deal one Personal and one Corporate secretly. First Intruder miniature of any type appearing triggers immediate choice by everyone before resolving its Encounter. Remove rejected card face down unseen. Eggs do not trigger it.
Discard the played card and two additional Action cards face up. Contamination cannot pay costs. Choose one OR effect.
At end of their own round take 1 Light Wound. Passing bars further Actions this Phase and allows discarding any number from hand. No further Fire wounds from later players rounds this turn.

Reveal Room and Exploration token; set counter to token number except Nest/Slime Room; resolve effect and remove Exploration token from game. Roll Noise in empty Room unless Silence or Danger exploration cancels it. Occupied Room (Character or Intruder) gives no movement Noise roll.

Cost 2 Action cards; replaces post-movement Noise roll with placing Noise in a chosen connected Corridor. Forbidden in Combat or when all destination Corridors have Noise. Closed Doors block player movement; no miniature stops in Corridors.

Resolve Encounter: remove all connected Noise including Technical Corridors; draw bag token; place matching Intruder; compare token number to all cards in triggering hand including Contamination. Fewer cards causes Surprise Attack against triggerer, equal or more does not. Set token aside.

Move all neighboring Intruders not in Combat into current Room. If none eligible, put Noise in each connected Corridor lacking it including Technical Corridors. Moving Intruder into occupied Room is Combat, not Encounter. Slime converts Silence Noise/exploration results to Danger.

Encounter replaces connected Noise in every Corridor; return Blank; add Adult only if Blank was last token in bag and a spare Adult is available; no miniature or Surprise Attack. Development always attempts adding one available Adult then returns Blank.
Both stay in original Room and destroy Door simultaneously. Destroyed Door permits movement but cannot close except Plasma Torch. Noise-triggered appearance ignores Closed Door.
Remove miniature, discard injuries, return matching token to bag; keep Noise. Characters barred except Mechanic Technical Corridors card and Technical Corridor Plans Item; Doors never placed there.

Both cost 1 Action card against target in same Room. Shoot needs Weapon in Hand and spends 1 Ammo; normal two-hit deals 2 injuries subject to Weapon. Melee draws Contamination to Action discard before choosing target, miss causes Serious Wound, two-hit deals only 1 injury.

Larva dies at 1 injury without Carcass. Adult draws one Attack card blood, dies if blood <= current injuries and leaves Carcass. Queen draws two, sums blood and compares same way; any Retreat arrow causes retreat via Event-card corridor number, discard Event, rather than normal numerical resolution.

Pay Movement cost 1, choose neighboring Room. Before moving resolve separate Attack from each Intruder targeting escaper. Death leaves Corpse in starting Room; survival completes move and standard exploration/Noise.

Fewest Action cards in hand; tie First Player or next in turn order. Matching attacker symbol on drawn Attack card means resolve effect; otherwise miss; ignore blood and discard card. Larva draws no Attack card: place miniature on target Character board and give Contamination on top of Action discard.

No: dressed still counts; any further Wound kills at three Serious. Third Light clears Light track and causes Serious Wound. Heal removes specified Light Wound or discards dressed Serious card. Place Corpse and drop Heavy Objects in death Room.

Canteen/Shower optionally scan hand Contamination, remove non-Infected; infected gives Larva and retains card, existing Larva means death/Creeper. Canteen heals 1 Light; Shower removes Slime. Surgery scans deck/hand/discard, removes infected and Larva, then 1 Light Wound, automatic pass, shuffle all cards including hand into deck; empty hand until next turn.

Each Injury from Shoot/Melee destroys 1 uncarried Egg. The manual explicitly waives Contamination and Wounds on a missed Egg Melee; its trailing if-they-miss wording does not uniquely settle whether successful Egg Melee also avoids Contamination. Do not invent a successful-hit draw, refund, or unconditional immunity. Grenade destroys 2 Eggs, Molotov 1; Noise after every destruction attempt including miss. Fire destroys 1 uncarried Egg each Fire Damage step. Nest destroyed once all its Eggs taken/destroyed; mark Injury in Nest.

answers.expected_answer: Use corresponding Evacuation Room Action cost 2 with unlocked pod and free space, no Intruder or Malfunction; roll Noise first and fail if Intruder reaches Room. Two Character spaces; Objects use none. Enter then launch immediately or wait; launch at first-round start in later Player Phase, voluntary free exit during round, no launch automatically passes. Intruder appearing in Section returns all pod occupants to Room; another boarder may launch immediately.

Engines then Coordinates then Contamination then Objectives. If ship survives to checks: two/three Damaged explodes kills all aboard incl Intruders; non-Earth kills sleepers but ship/Intruders survive, Quarantine sleeper survives Mars. All survivors including launched pod passengers scan all Contamination; any infected triggers shuffle all Action/Contamination draw 4, any Contamination kills else survives. Larva skips scanning and directly does shuffle/draw. Survivors then reveal/check chosen Objective.
